title: King of the AI Jungle — Post-Workshop Feedback Survey
description: Structured feedback survey for the King of the AI Jungle workshop. Collected during the wrap-up segment (02:45–03:00).

session_id.description: Unique identifier for the workshop session (e.g., '2026-11-10-morning').

path_id.description: Path ID from the 2-Axis model (A1–A4, B1–B4, C1–C4, D1–D4, E1–E4, F1–F4).

content_relevance.description: How relevant was the workshop content to your role? (1–5, where 1=Not relevant, 5=Extremely relevant).

instructor_effectiveness.description: How effective was the instructor? (1–5, where 1=Poor, 5=Excellent).

time_management.description: How well was the workshop time managed? (1–5, where 1=Very poor, 5=Excellent).

tooling_experience.description: How was your experience with the workshop tooling? (1–5, where 1=Very difficult, 5=Seamless).

overall_value.description: How would you rate the overall value of this workshop? (1–5, where 1=No value, 5=Exceptional value).

most_valuable_part.description: What was the most valuable part of the workshop?

what_to_improve.description: What should we improve for the next session?
